title: The Frozen Army
text: An army stands frozen in ranks on a plain of ice, mid-march, every face turned the same way. Frost coats their beards. Their banners hang stiff in a wind that stopped centuries ago, and they bear the arms of a House long fallen.

options.label: Walk among their ranks, and pray none of them wake.

outcomes.text: They do not move. You feel their eyes anyway, all the way across the ice.

options.label: The strongest pries loose a captain's sword. He will not need it now.

outcomes.text: Fine steel, and as it comes free, the whole army turns its heads to watch you go.

options.label: Salute them, and go around. They marched for a House, as you do.

outcomes.text: Their stiff banners stir, once, in no wind, as if returning the honour.
